data_boundary.android_ios_face_photo_evidence: Official Android/iOS privacy material describes face coordinates and album photos as local processing with no transmission or reporting; it also describes anonymous encrypted SDK-usage reporting.
data_boundary.web_image_processing_evidence: The reviewed Web static-image tutorial processes an input image in a browser SDK flow, but the reviewed material does not establish a complete Web image-egress, retention or telemetry guarantee for this project.
data_boundary.region_evidence: No reviewed first-party material established a data-processing region or cross-border route for the selected SDK surface.

evidence_review.review_scope: Tencent official first-party materials only; no account console, License, SDK package, credential, photo or network call was used.

batch.finding: The reviewed static-image guide demonstrates a single selected image; no first-party batch maximum or batch API was established in this review.

license_and_pricing_findings.web_test_license: Official Web quick-start documentation describes a test License for local testing, 14 days with one renewal for up to 28 days, and one test License per account; this project has not obtained one.
license_and_pricing_findings.web_binding: One Web License binds one domain and one mini-program AppId; localhost is supported for debugging according to the reviewed pricing documentation.
license_and_pricing_findings.mobile_pc: Official materials show separate mobile/PC licensing and package pricing; one License cannot bind both mobile and PC. Exact selected package and cost remain a product decision and vendor verification item.
license_and_pricing_findings.current_project_status: no test License, production License, package download, bound domain/app identifier or vendor billing evidence

privacy_region_latency_findings.privacy: The SDK's official privacy/compliance materials require informed user consent before initialization and state Android/iOS face and album-photo handling as local/no transmission or reporting, while SDK usage records may be anonymous-encrypted reported. This does not establish the Web route's full image outbound/retention behavior.
privacy_region_latency_findings.retention: No exact vendor image retention/deletion SLA was found in the reviewed first-party materials for the selected future Web/PC/mobile surface.
privacy_region_latency_findings.region: No exact processing region or cross-border data route was found in the reviewed first-party materials.
privacy_region_latency_findings.latency: No official p50/p95 latency or static-image throughput claim was found in the reviewed materials.
